title: David July x John Thomas Deliver Energetic Vibes with "Do It Again."
htmlContent:
David July, the rising star of Vancouver's music scene, teams up with producer John Thomas to create a high-energy trap anthem in "Do It Again." The song showcases David's ability to blend genres with his melodic hip-hop style and autotuned vocals, while John Thomas brings the beats that will have listeners nodding along.

Lyrically, "Do It Again" is about living life on your terms and not letting anyone bring you down. David's confident delivery and catchy hooks make this a perfect song to blast when you need motivation or want to feel good. This Canada-USA-based collaboration is a must-listen for fans of trap, rap, and genre-fusing music.
